verdict.rationale: Moss exposes a versioned API: the API reference lives under a /v1/ path and all actions route through the `/v1/manage` endpoint. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-migration guidance, and no OpenAPI spec was found by the probe. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle/sunset guarantees, changelog or migration docs, machine-readable versioned API spec.
